description_zh: 删除已创建的资源栈组
kebab_example: aliyun ros delete-stack-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --stack-group-name MyStackGroup --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteStackGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region to which the stack group belongs. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 资源栈组所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the stack group. The name must be unique in a region.

The name can be up to 255 characters in length and can contain digits, letters, hyphens (-), and underscores (_). The name must start with a digit or a letter
parameters.help_zh:
资源栈组名称。名称在单个地域内唯一。   
长度不超过255个字符，必须以数字或英文字母开头，可包含数字、英文字母、短划线（-）和下划线（_）
parameters.name: stack_group_name
